Nothing at (3,7) — the player isn't interactable either.

I've now spent extensive effort. Let me reconsider the fundamental issue: the notice board at (2,7) blocks, and I'm on it. This is a spawn soft-lock.

However — one thing I haven't tried: maybe the notice board is at (2,7) but I can move if I press the direction toward a tile that the board doesn't block. The board blocks its own tile (2,7). To leave (2,7), I move to an adjacent tile. The board shouldn't block leaving. Unless the game checks "can I be on this tile" and since I'm on a blocking tile, it disables all movement.

Let me try a completely fresh idea: maybe the game has a "read notice" that requires me to be adjacent, and the notice board is actually at (2,7) but I'm at (2,7) and the game considers me adjacent to it (0 tiles). Pressing E should read it. But E targets front tile.

Let me try pressing E while facing DOWN and UP repeatedly with the board being a wall-mounted object on the north or south wall of my tile. I'll try facing UP (board on north wall, read from my tile facing up) — already did, nothing at (2,6).

I'm going to try the last resort: maybe the notice board is at (2,7) and I need to interact with it, and the interaction is triggered by pressing E when the notice board is the nearest object AND I'm facing it. Since it's on my tile, let me try pressing E while facing each direction but with the board being "in front" — maybe the game's front-tile check includes my own tile when facing a wall.

Let me try facing UP and pressing E, then check if a panel opened by observing.
